messages:
Maya (PM): Quick note from today's UX review — the in-console docs panel uses 'Pin model' but the docs use 'Pin model version'. Customers tripped over that during onboarding.

Kevin (Design): Yep saw the confusion. Also the panel 'Learn more' link lands at the top of the docs page, not the pinning section.

Sylvia (DevEx): Our link helper currently returns /docs/models. We should accept an optional fragment so components can link to /docs/models#pin-model-version.

Raj (Eng): I can add fragment support and make external links open in a new tab with rel="noopener". Want me to also add an aria-label?

Emma (A11y): Yes please. Aria-label like 'Opens documentation in a new tab' and make the icon keyboard-focusable. Also add aria-controls on the inlay close button.

Maya (PM): Decision: standardize on 'Pin model version' everywhere and deep-link to '#pin-model-version'. Docs team will add the id; design to switch to sentence case.

Kevin (Design): I'll change the CTA to 'See pinning docs' and update the small spacing around the external icon.

Sylvia (DevEx): I'll add a short note to the docs style guide: sentence case for headings referenced by in-product panels. Also will add a redirect for old links.

Raj (Eng): I'll ship the helper change + unit tests tomorrow AM and add a tiny e2e that diffs console labels vs docs headings to catch future mismatches.

DocBot: Linter update queued: require-doc-anchors now flags links without fragment when referenced from frontend. PR link: https://git.internal/rdw/pulls/421

Maya (PM): Great. If anyone finds other wording mismatches (reserved/dedicated capacity, routing labels), drop them here. Closing once PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
